name: ddd
description: The 9-step DDD Starter Modelling Process as a chained skill pipeline over one shared ddd/ workspace: understand, discover, decompose, strategize, connect, organise, define, code, contracts. Every step validates its JSON artifact against a schema before the next may run, records its hard calls as decisions with every option weighed, and rebuilds a self-contained review page with SVG/PNG diagrams (context map, core domain chart, message flows, teams and deployables, C4 context, aggregates, event storm) and decision comparisons; the run ends with a blueprint final render. Runs on Node.js 18 or newer with nothing to install. Includes blueprint, the bundled diagram renderer (architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML) that `ddd export blueprint --deliver` uses and that can be used on its own. Start with ddd-workflow.
